metadata.title: SpaceX Stock: Elon Musk Just Gave Verizon, AT&T, Other Telecoms Some Great News<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
SpaceX CEO Elon Musk Just Gave Telecoms Some Great News
Telecom investors got some great news from SpaceX CEO Elon Musk. He expects to launch mobile wireless service in two to three years.
